200.description:
One Azerty.nl product page by article number or URL: name, brand, manufacturer part number, EAN, EUR price incl. VAT, schema.org availability, Dutch delivery-time line, category trail, description, editorial pros and cons, rating and the full specification table.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `availability` | string | schema.org availability token from the offer, e.g. `InStock`, `OutOfStock`, `PreOrder`, `Discontinued`. |
| `brand` | string | Brand as the site writes it (often upper case, e.g. `SAMSUNG`); null when absent. |
| `breadcrumbs` | object[] | Category trail without the home page and the product itself. |
| `category` | string | Category path as the page states it, e.g. `Componenten / M.2 SSD's / SSD's`. |
| `cons` | string[] | Editorial minus points (`Minpunten`); empty when none. |
| `country` | string | Market of the storefront: NL. |
| `currency` | string | Currency of every price: EUR. |
| `description` | string | Product description as plain text (Dutch). |
| `ean` | string | EAN/GTIN-13; null when the page lists none. |
| `image_url` | string |  |
| `language` | string | Storefront language: nl. |
| `manufacturer_part_number` | string | Manufacturer part number (`Fabrikantcode`); null when the page lists none. |
| `name` | string |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number | Unix epoch milliseconds when the page was read. |
| `price` | number | Offer price in EUR including VAT; null when no price is offered (discontinued articles show 0.00). |
| `product_id` | string | Azerty article number (`sku`). |
| `pros` | string[] | Editorial plus points (`Pluspunten`); empty when none. |
| `rating` | object | Customer rating out of 5; null when the product has no reviews (the site then shows 0 of 5 stars and asks for the first review). |
| `specs` | object[] | Specification table rows in page order (`Productspecificaties`). |
| `stock_text` | string | Delivery-time line in Dutch, e.g. `Volgende werkdag in huis`. |
| `url` | string | Canonical product page. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

value.description: De 990 PRO SSD van Samsung heeft een opslagcapaciteit van 2 TB. Deze M.2 SSD heeft een leessnelheid van 7450 MB/sec en een schrijfsnelheid van 6900 MB/sec. De SSD is daarnaast voorzien van een M.2 (2280) bouwvorm met een PCIe Gen 4.0 x4, NVMe 2.0 interface.De 990 PRO serie M.2 SSD van Samsung combineert Samsung V7 V-NAND 3-bit MLC met de Samsung controller voor verbluffende lees/schrijfsnelheden om zo een nieuwe standaard te creëren voor high-end gaming en 4K & 3D video editing. Met random (QD32) lees- en schrijfsnelheden van 1.400K IOPS en 1.550K IOPS.

pros: De SSD is tot wel 50% zuiniger dan de 980 PRO.
Deze schijf heeft een hoge leessnelheid van 6900 megabyte per seconde en is daardoor 3 keer sneller dan de meeste SATA SSD's.

post.description: Finding products on the Dutch IT retailer Azerty from a keyword, brand or model (e.g. `samsung 990 pro`, `logitech muis`). Follow `next_page_input` for more results and pass an item's `product_id` to `product` for full details.

page.description:
Result page, 24 products each (default 1). A page past the last result page is `invalid_input`.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 500.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Keyword search over the Azerty.nl catalogue, one page of up to 24 products in the site's relevance order: article number, name, short spec line, EUR price (incl. and excl. VAT), delivery-time text and product URL. Some keywords redirect to a category page (`landing: listing`) and an exact article number or EAN to its product page (`landing: product`); both are reported as results. Listing cards carry no ratings; use `product` for those.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | number |  |
| `country` | string | Market of the storefront: NL. |
| `currency` | string | Currency of every price: EUR. |
| `has_more` | boolean |  |
| `items` | object[] |  |
| `landing` | string | Which page answered: `search` the result list; `listing` a category or brand page the site's search redirects some keywords to (e.g. `ssd`); `product` the product page an exact article number or EAN redirects to. |
| `language` | string | Storefront language: nl. |
| `next_page` | number | Next page number, null on the last page. |
| `next_page_input` | object | Input for the next page of this search; null on the last page. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number | Unix epoch milliseconds when the page was read. |
| `page` | number |  |
| `page_size` | number | Products per page: 24. |
| `query` | string | Normalized query (whitespace collapsed). |
| `source_url` | string | URL of the page that answered after redirects. |
| `total` | number | Total matching products the page reports. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
